dct_creator_sm: Milner, Matthew (Memorial University of Newfoundland). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9113-1468
dct_description_sm: This dataset comprises revised TEI headers for the Early English Books Online Text Creation Partnership Phase I files which were created as part of the Distant Reading Early Modernity subproject for the Early Modern Conversions SSHRC Partnership project based at McGill 2012-18. It combines the existing Phase I TEI XML Metadata with matching identifiers for authors & publishers from the Virtual Identify Authority Files (VIAF) and matching entries by title and place of publication from OCLC. Confidence markers are assigned to possible matching identifiers. For full explanation of the methodology, see https://www.matthewmilner.name/2015/11/17/EEBO-TCP-Metadata-Mashup/
dct_title_s: EEBO-TCP Phase I Metadata Headers for DREaM
